arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS period_results, COUNT(d.driverId) AS matched_results, MIN(d.dob) AS earliest_dob, MAX(d.dob) AS latest_dob, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dob = date(d.dob) THEN 1 END) AS iso_dates, COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(res.laps) = 'integer' THEN 1 END) AS integer_laps
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;
